sitio.subtitulo: Compare medicine prices across Peruvian pharmacies
sitio.descripcion: Medicine and supplement prices at Inkafarma, Mifarma, Boticas Perú and Farmacia Universal, matched product by product.
filtros.soloTodas: Only products sold by every active pharmacy
tabla.caption: Prices by pharmacy. The lowest price in each row is marked.
producto.aRevisar.detalle: More than 3× between the most and least expensive chain. Usually a match between different products: not counted as savings.
producto.verEn: View at {cadena} (opens in a new tab)
vacio.texto: Try another name or active ingredient, or remove a filter.
pie.aviso: Independent project. Not affiliated with any of the pharmacies listed; their names and logos belong to their owners. Prices are public, may change and should be confirmed at each store.
ficha.precios.caption: Price of this pack size at each chain, with a link to the store.
ficha.rango.insuficiente: {rango}: fewer than two days with data
ficha.grafico.unDia: So far there are prices for a single day ({fecha}). The history grows with every daily run.
ficha.grafico.leyenda: Each chain has its own line style and marker. Filled marker: on promotion. Dotted segment: days without data between two captures.
ficha.eventos.ninguno: No price changes or promotions in the recorded period.
ficha.match.intro: How each chain's listing was judged to be the same product:
ficha.match.inkafarma: Reference: the product and pack size come from Inkafarma's catalog.
ficha.match.mifarma: Same product code as Inkafarma: both chains belong to the same group and share a catalog.
ficha.match.fuzzy: Same sanitary registration or barcode when the store publishes it; otherwise a similar name, the exact same pack size and no clash in manufacturer, strength, dosage form or active ingredient. The price must also be within 3× of Inkafarma's.
ficha.match.nota: The photo only confirms a match, it never rules one out. Details are in Methodology.
ficha.og: From {monto} at {cadena}. Compare the price across 4 pharmacies in Peru.
panorama.descripcion: Which chain is cheapest, how far it sits from the lowest price and how many promotions it runs, overall and by category.
panorama.intro: Figures from the {fecha} capture, over {n} products priced in at least two chains.
panorama.brecha: Gap: how much more a product costs in that chain than in the cheapest one. 0 % = it is the cheapest.
panorama.empates: When two chains tie on the lowest price, both count as cheapest. Boticas Perú and Farmacia Universal only count on products where the same item was found.
panorama.porCategoria.intro: Share of the category's products where each chain has the lowest price (in brackets, how many products it compares).
metodologia.descripcion: How prices are captured and matched, what the comparison covers and what it does not, and who is behind it.
lab.intro: 12 real products to test interaction. Lab page, not part of the site.
lab.buscar.ayuda: ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to pick, Esc to close
